svg.title: Presentation board for P3, a sales, purchasing and inventory system for a wholesale shop designed in Figma: sales dashboard, master item list with minimum stock, and a printable sales report. Demo data.
svg.text: P3 · Sales, purchasing and inventory for a wholesale shop
Cashier, stock, purchase requests, suppliers and reports in one admin
01 Dashboard: sales trend, best sellers, items at minimum stock
02 Master item: prices, stock and minimum stock
03 Sales report: preview, share and download
Figma · dashboard and 2 key screens. Demo data, shop name removed.
